sentences.text: Task 2. You will listen to a presentation by Danny I describing some of the features of the new website to Mr.
Law, Rob Lee and Cherry Tam.
Listen to, the presentation and fill in the missing information in the spaces provided on the website pages.
One has been done for you as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers.
OK, if you're ready Denny, you can start now.
Thanks, Rob, and thanks to Mr.
Law and Cherry for coming to my presentation I'm going to show you our first draft design for the new College Website.
It's still a bit rough but I hope you can get the idea.
here. To start with, on the screen here you can see the home page of the website with the College logo in the top left corner and the name of the College of course.
Then on the right is a box labelled Search for people to search the site using keywords.
And they can search anywhere in the site?
Yeah, that’s right, Mr Law.
OK, so on the next row down, from left to right we have the tabs for the individual pages of the website: the Home page, which is the one we're on now, then there’s a page called About Us where
you have all the information about the College, including its history, its mission, the staff and so on.
And then we have the Students page, which I'll come to later.
a page for Parents, so that they can get information about the College from their perspective.
Then we have a Subjects page, which will include things like the course outlines, and finally there’s a page for Extra-Curricular Activities.
Ooh, there are nice photos below that Yeah, I just used ones from the old website.
You can see three just now, but it’s actually a gallery of twelve which will change every five seconds.
The captions below will change as well.
At present I’ve put up three photos and called them Sports day The one in the middle I’ve called Study at AC and the other one is A recent visit
Is that you Cherry in the Study at AC photo?
Yeah, that’s me.
Holding up my hand!
Right, moving on.
Now, on the left of the page left of the welcome message from the principal you can see three separate boxes.
These are for important information that you want your visitors to see first.
The first is for Upcoming Events People can simply click on the link and go to the interactive calendar.
Then next is the Latest News section.
You can see that I’ve added in a link to a story.
a College wins cup?
Yes, I just made that up as a demonstration.
Actually the College has just won the District Handball Cup so it’s right Excellent.
Right, where was I?
Right, the next one.
Well, again this is just a demo, I called this one Have your your say It could be a link to a place where students and teachers can make comments on the College.
Hmm. Have your say I like the sound of it but I'm not sure I'd like what the students might post there!
Hmm. OK. And that’s about it for the home page.
Good. Have you had time to work on any of the other pages?
Yeah, OK. we've been working on the Students page.
Just a second.
So here it is.
The Students Page.
There will be all the same things at the top of the page as on the home page, so I haven't included them on the demo.
Oh you can see three different photos here The difference The difference is in the menus on the left side of the page, where you can see that we have various links to places in the site that
will be of interest to the students.
So we have Transport at the top of the list Good.
If the students can’t get here then you can’t teach them very much can you?
That's what I always say!
Yes, so, transport, and then we have Canteen, The next one’s something quite new, and this is the equaint, the social networking facility
that we have introduced.
It’s still in production so we can’t show it to you yet, but users will be able to access it from here.
I’ve You've just included some examples of what you could do with a quaint.
The examples I've put here are share content, meet new friends, and, maybe the most important, build relationships.
Yep. Looks good.
That last one build relationships it'd be really good if we could use the website to build relationships, you know between students students and students and between students and teachers.
Yeah. So, the other major thing we've included on the menu On the Students page is Akadeem.
the new learning management system.
Eko, what? Akadeem, A -C -A -D -E -M -E.
it means the academic or learning environment And also begins with AC, for Aberdeen College!
Oh, yeah, very good.
And again, we're working on that and hope to have it ready for you to see soon.
So after Academe we have a link to the library and then two links are to the dreaded examinations!
We have separate separate links to Exam Information and Exam Results.
Yeah, well exams are on everybody's minds.
So good yeah.
We can provide the information here.
I don’t know what you're looking so worried about, Cherry.
As far as I can gather you do pretty well in examinations anyway.
Well, it depends on the subject.
And that’s about it so far.
